lessons.lesson: A visibility flag that game logic reads as state must not double as a render switch: castle_room_layer.visible means 'the castle is the surface' to a dozen checks, so a clip hides the layer's children instead and leaves the flag alone.

A measured state whose capture moment varies (a caption up or not, a cross-fade or a clip) gives different numbers on the same code. The Opera careers moved by up to 0.33 layers and the Pool's entry_transition alternated between the cross-fade (4.38) and the arrival clip (2.03). Compare the drawn item names before claiming a change, and name which composition the published run caught.

An owner answer that fits more than one implementation is recorded verbatim and asked back with numbered readings and their consequences before code changes; the clear answers in the same reply are applied at once.
